title.narrative: Protection and promotion of human rights of Persons with Albinism in Mozambique (PWA)

description.narrative: The initiative will focus on promotion and protection of human rights of persons with albinism (PWA) with emphasis on education and culture for behavior change, legal and medical response to the stigmatization and human rights violations of PWA. Intervention will entail combination of awareness raising, public information campaigns through traditional and modern media and social media; including also capacity building of various stakeholders to acquire knowledge on nature, origins and cause of albinism in order to combat and discourage myths leading to killing, assassinations and violations of human rights of PWA.
